back.hook: Dust is not the end. It is the staging ground of resurrection grace.
paragraphs: 1 Peter lives closest to the ground of any New Testament letter -- written to exiles facing a fiery trial, yet declaring that God has caused you to be born again to a living hope. Twelve weeks walk straight through it, to the humility that waits on God's mighty hand.

“The Six Faces of the Dust” names what the psalmist meant by a soul clinging to dust, so whatever face yours wears, you know it is the ground He stoops to reach. Ransomed and called a living stone, you are not too far down for this letter.
items: The full passage in the World English Bible
Five word studies in Greek and Hebrew, each with a Live It response
Five Life Application practices and a daily prayer
A Bottom Line and a “Lift Up Your Eyes” benediction
